1.consolidated_definition: Buscar provecho tan pronto se presente la oportunidad. “Acepta ese trabajo, aunque no sea el mejor. Cuando estés allí, ya te acomodarás en la primera curva.”
1.en_consolidated_definition: To seize an opportunity for personal gain as soon as it arises. "Accept that job, even if it's not the best one. Once you're there, you'll find your footing in due time."
